claims.assertion: Mari defines an archon as a powerful, manipulative lower-astral entity with a crude hierarchy; she says archons are organized demons.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She distinguishes this from broader religious descriptions.

claims.assertion: She says demons depend on living beings' attention and fear for manifestation energy, and can be created as individual or group egregors.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She describes fear as concentrating attention.

claims.assertion: Mari suggests Earth controllers use demon beliefs and fear of eternal punishment to make populations obedient and dependent on religious systems.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She frames this as a probable use.
